summary: release.yaml goes from 10 sequential job stages to 3: four builds with no needs (the changes job deleted, each build deciding from tags); one credentialed publish job for all four packages beside the worker-image build (call 1 of worker-image.yaml); attest (call 2, gated on the plugin pair having published) beside the image version tag and release note. release-envoy-infra.yaml is already at its floor of 2. Replace-pending stays (architect's decision).

implement: legion-worker: the phase contracts, PR body and proof rules, and the production check after the close that delivers acceptance 1 and 4
ce-simplify-code: the simplify pass over the restructured release.yaml and worker-image.yaml before the proof
test: legion-worker: proof entries, re-running T9 and T6, and the test handoff
review: legion-worker: the merge-gate reference for approving the head and checking the PR body's proofs against the release credential rules

findings.finding: Verification: bump commits of two different packages rebase without conflict in push-main, but only when each bump is one commit on the run's commit (release-push.sh 533-569, 597-620); the serial-publish comments (release.yaml 809-813, 1005-1009) and credential rule 4 are wrong as written.
findings.answer: Decision 4: one publish job, each package's steps start with git checkout --detach $GITHUB_SHA; the wrong comments and rule 4 go (T1, T3).

findings.finding: Verification: legion_build needs only version strings from the plugin jobs (release.yaml 281-358), but the daemon installs the linked pair from npm on a stale-plugin relaunch (cmd/legion/main.go 60-67, 205-218).
findings.answer: Decision 3 (legion_build computes the pair) and decisions 4 and 6 (legion and the attested image only when the pair published or had nothing to release).

findings.finding: Verification: worker-image.yaml builds without legion_publish's outputs; legion_version only adds the :<version> tag and a label no one reads (worker-image.yaml 138-141, 196).
findings.answer: Decision 7: the version tag moves to worker_image_release after publish; T2 removes the dead workflow_call input.

findings.finding: Verification: consumers that parse release.yaml: skills-partition.test.ts 73-123, check-release-credentials rule 4 and rule 6, check-image-trigger-paths, the production-check wake by step name.
findings.answer: T3, T4, T5 update the checks and test; the wake reads only agent-infra envoy.yaml step Apply (agent-infra legion/Pulumi.prod.yaml 544-547), so no release.yaml name is read.

findings.finding: A1: in one publish job, tag/tagged/push-main need each package to start from $GITHUB_SHA and legion to tag $GITHUB_SHA explicitly; otherwise reruns and push-main break.
findings.answer: Decision 4 (detach per package, git tag "$TAG" "$GITHUB_SHA"); T6 tests the composition and a rerun, with a no-detach control; T9(c) probes it.

findings.finding: A2: one job with fail-fast steps changes today's per-package failure semantics; behaviour when one build fails is undefined.
findings.answer: Decision 4: each plugin publishes independently (if: !cancelled() and its own build); legion only when pi-envoy and pi-legion each published or had nothing; T9(c) forces failures and shows which packages ship.

findings.finding: A3: worker_image computing the pair in-job needs full history, --package-dir, a non-main rule and an equality check; AGENTS.md 144 says one version call per build job.
findings.answer: Changed design: the image build takes the pair from legion_build (call 1 needs legion_build), so worker-image.yaml computes nothing; off main the pair is empty (decision 8); AGENTS.md 144-145 updated (T7).

findings.finding: A4: check-image-trigger-paths refuses an inputs.* gate on worker-image.yaml's build job needed for an attest-only call.
findings.answer: T4 admits an input-vs-literal test on worker-image.yaml's jobs as neutral, with a passing case and a refusal control.

findings.finding: A5: a shared version-args script under .github/scripts cannot run in a credentialed job (DEPENDENCY_PATH, check-release-credentials.sh 189).
findings.answer: Decision 2: the arguments live in the workflow env (release-envoy-listener.yaml LEGION_ENVOY_VERSION_ARGS precedent); checks in publish are inline shell; T5 reads the lists from the env.

findings.finding: A6: attest gate undefined when publish is skipped; today attest runs on every non-PR run, branch dispatches included.
findings.answer: Decision 6: attest when call 1 succeeded and (off main or pair_ok); decision 8 keeps the branch-dispatch attest.

findings.finding: A7: the release note and tag beside attest can name an unattested digest if attest fails.
findings.answer: Decision 7: accepted and stated on the PR: the consumers' gh attestation verify refuses an unattested digest, so it fails closed.

findings.finding: A8: docker/setup-buildx-action is not on CREDENTIALED_USES; buildx availability unverified.
findings.answer: Decision 7 uses docker/login-action and the runner's own buildx, as release-envoy-listener.yaml release_publish does (its lines 153-175).

findings.finding: B1: spec Outcome and title (30 minutes, never cancelled) contradict acceptance v2 and the architect's decision.
findings.answer: Spec departure 2: the plan delivers the acceptance lines; the architect restates the Outcome and title.

findings.finding: B2: acceptance 1 names changes diffing from the last successful run, which the design deletes.
findings.answer: Spec departure 1: the reason becomes tags alone.

findings.finding: B3: acceptance 2 admits only credential reasons for a stage; stage 3 has others.
findings.answer: Stage 3 holds attest's id-token/attestations write apart from the job that ran the Dockerfile, and the image build needs stage-1 versions; the publish gate on attest costs no stage. Stage table states each reason.

findings.finding: B4: stage and merge-to-published have no definition or command; 'about 6 h a run' is run duration, not merge-to-published; stage 1 now starts 4 builds and the image every run.
findings.answer: Plan defines stage; T8 measures merge-to-published per artifact (npm time, release publishedAt, attest completed_at) before and after with one script; decision 1 states the cost of starting builds and the image every run.

findings.finding: B5: acceptance 1's window is undefined.
findings.answer: Acceptance table row 1: the 24 h after the merge, mapped by git tag --contains per package to the releasing run.

findings.finding: B6: acceptances 1 and 4 need post-merge evidence; the PR's own merge may publish nothing.
findings.answer: Rows 1 and 4 go to the implementer's production check on the PR's Production: line, read from the first runs that publish after the merge.

findings.finding: B7: nothing proves the publish job before merge; branch dispatch skips publish.
findings.answer: T9(c): a probe in sjawhar/legion-smoke (LEGION-779 precedent) with the exact graph and conditions, plus T6's local git test of the publish composition; T9(b) branch dispatch for the image calls.

findings.finding: C1: docs list misses AGENTS.md 144-145, skills/AGENTS.md 25, pi-envoy and pi-legion READMEs, worker-image.yaml comments and inputs, docs/kubernetes.md rerun semantics.
findings.answer: T7 lists them all with a grep check; docs/solutions records stay as written.

findings.finding: C2: open PRs #2305, #2219, #2186 and INFRA-520 touch the same files.
findings.answer: Coordination list in the plan; whichever lands second resolves the real conflict; the architect sequences.

findings.finding: C3: the production-check wake matches step names of a deploy workflow.
findings.answer: Checked: INFRA's deploys names only theorem-labs/agent-infra .github/workflows/envoy.yaml step Apply.

findings.finding: D: unverified claims: npm trusted publishing keyed to workflow not job; calling one reusable workflow twice.
findings.answer: npm docs (docs.npmjs.com/trusted-publishers): fields are owner, repository, workflow filename, optional environment; release.yaml uses no environment. GitHub docs: 50 unique reusable workflows per file, one file counted once.

specDepartures.spec: Acceptance 1: GitHub replacing a pending run loses no commit because `changes` diffs from the last successful run and versions come from tags.
specDepartures.plan: Deletes the changes job; the no-loss reason is tags alone (each build releases every commit since its package's last tag).
specDepartures.evidence: release-push.sh version (header lines 10-33) skips only when nothing since the tag; release-envoy-infra.yaml lines 25-33 already rely on tags alone; deleting changes removes one runner wait.

acceptance: 1: the reason clause names tags alone instead of the changes job

specDepartures.spec: Outcome and title: a release job gets a runner within 30 minutes; no release run is cancelled or replaced while it waits.
specDepartures.plan: Delivers acceptance 1-2 of version 2: replace-pending kept; the fewest stages (3) instead of a 30-minute runner wait.
specDepartures.evidence: docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits: every standard runner label shares the account's one concurrent-job limit; larger runners only for organizations on Team/Enterprise; sjawhar is a User account. Architect's decision over Envoy 2026-10-27 02:55Z.

summary: Outcome: 'on a runner within 30 minutes' and 'No release run is cancelled while it waits' are not delivered
Title: 'never wait behind pull-request CI or get replaced while pending' is not delivered
